supersedes_contract_not_artifacts.note: This revises the SCIENTIFIC INVARIANT used to admit regions into a G3 affinity-representation evaluation cohort. It does NOT modify, reinterpret, or invalidate any prior frozen artifact. All prior artifacts remain the authoritative historical record.
supersedes_contract_not_artifacts.prior_rejection_of_C_E_remains_valid: TRAIN-C and TRAIN-E remain rejected under the PER-REGION both-class contract (COHORT-001 admission decision). That historical decision is not reversed; this artifact defines a different, cohort-level contract for a new dataset version.

old_invariant: Each individual TRAIN region must contain both SAME_PROCESS and DIFFERENT_PROCESS eligible interface evidence.

revision_motivation.diagnosed_incompatibility: The old per-region both-class rule and the per-axis both-class-in-both-splits requirement (needed for axis-leakage-safe affinity evaluation) are in direct conflict on the existing reviewed crop set. The per-region rule excludes exactly the crops (C, E) that carry Y x DIFFERENT_PROCESS, so the admitted cohort (A,B,D,F,G,H) is structurally forced into an axis confound (Z=DIFFERENT-only, Y/X=SAME-dominant).
revision_motivation.prospective_not_retroactive: This revision is made because of a diagnosed structural incompatibility in the real reviewed evidence, and the new contract is fully specified and justified BEFORE evaluating whether any dataset passes it. It is not a threshold reverse-engineered to make a failed metric pass.

new_contract.name: G3_AFFINITY_EVAL_COHORT_LEVEL_IDENTIFIABILITY_CONTRACT_V1
new_contract.unit_of_evidence: interface_id (member-agreement required; CONTRADICTORY / UNCERTAIN / BAD_QUESTION are not class evidence)
an_axis_is_EVALUABLE_iff_all_hold: C1 COVERAGE: the axis carries >=1 SAME_PROCESS and >=1 DIFFERENT_PROCESS interface in BOTH the TRAIN split and the VALIDATION split (cohort-level (axis x split x class) coverage).
C2 CROSS-REGION REPLICATION: within TRAIN, each of {SAME_PROCESS, DIFFERENT_PROCESS} for the axis appears in >=2 distinct spatially-independent crops (no single-crop class evidence).

C3 CLASS/CROP NON-COLLINEARITY: within TRAIN, the class must NOT be perfectly predictable from crop identity on that axis. Concretely at least one of: (a) >=1 crop supplies BOTH classes on the axis (within-region contrast), OR (b) the SAME-supplying and DIFFERENT-supplying crop sets overlap such that a leave-one-crop-out split cannot linearly separate class by crop identity. If SAME and DIFFERENT come from strictly DISJOINT crop sets, C3 FAILS.
C4 SPATIAL INDEPENDENCE: all TRAIN and VALIDATION regions remain spatially disjoint (existing G3 invariant, unchanged).
new_contract.cohort_is_valid_iff: at least one axis is EVALUABLE under C1-C4, and the protected volume MV-GTVOL-000004 is absent.
new_contract.rationale: C1 prevents axis leakage (a class only on some axes). C2 prevents single-crop idiosyncrasy. C3 is the key addition: it prevents merely MOVING the confound from physical axis to crop appearance, i.e. a classifier scoring by learning per-crop texture instead of process affinity. C4 preserves voxel-level independence. This is the weakest set that blocks BOTH axis and crop/region confounding; weaker (dropping C3) would readmit C/E but leave class perfectly collinear with crop on axis Y.
new_contract.thresholds_justification: >=2 crops (C2) is the minimum for any replication. C3 requires breaking perfect collinearity rather than a tuned margin, so it is not fit to the current dataset. No threshold here was selected because A-H happens to pass it; see verdict below (A-H FAILS).

audit_verdict_against_new_contract.dataset_evaluated: all reviewed TRAIN A-H (interface-level, event logs -001..-004)

Z.reason: Z has zero SAME_PROCESS interfaces in TRAIN

Y.reason: Y SAME comes only from {A,B,D,F,G,H}; Y DIFFERENT comes only from {C,E}; crop sets are DISJOINT => class perfectly collinear with crop; no crop carries both Y classes

X.reason: X DIFFERENT unique to crop E (no replication) and disjoint from X SAME crops

audit_verdict_against_new_contract.conclusion: No axis is EVALUABLE under the new cohort-level identifiability contract using the existing A-H evidence. Admitting TRAIN-C/E would satisfy C1/C2 on Y but FAILS C3: Y class remains perfectly collinear with crop identity. This is a crop confound substituted for the axis confound, which the contract explicitly forbids.

required_next_action.description: Because A-H (with or without C/E) cannot satisfy C3 on any axis, follow the previously sanctioned path: select new spatially-independent TRAIN region(s) and collect ONLY the evidence required to break class/crop collinearity on a target axis. Specifically, the cheapest identifiability fix is to obtain, on a single axis, at least one crop that contains BOTH SAME_PROCESS and DIFFERENT_PROCESS interfaces on that axis (within-region contrast), reviewed fresh and label-blind.
do_not: mutate or reinterpret -002 or the COHORT-001 admission decision
admit C/E and declare success (fails C3)
mine A/B/D/F/G/H further for a class the audit shows is crop-collinear

negative_evidence_preserved.note: The -003 and -004 stratified Y/TRAIN review batches are RETAINED as real negative evidence: broad label-blind sampling across rank bands on A/B/D produced only SAME_PROCESS, consistent with the audit finding that Y-DIFFERENT is confined to C/E.

downstream_gate: No CellposeDINO/ViT-B affinity evaluation, reconstruction, connectivity, or connectome step may proceed until a cohort satisfies G3_AFFINITY_EVAL_COHORT_LEVEL_IDENTIFIABILITY_CONTRACT_V1.
